subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Test Series · FMGE Test Series Year 2021 · Fmge National Mock Test #3 (Part I)

questions.stem: A 40-year old female underwent total thyroidectomy for papillary carcinoma of the thyroid. On the third postoperative day, the patient complains of numbness in her fingers and perioral area. Her serum calcium level is 6 mg/dl. Which of the following vessels would have been injured during the surgery, resulting in this clinical scenario?
questions.stemHtml: A 40-year old female underwent total thyroidectomy for papillary carcinoma of the thyroid. On the third postoperative day, the patient complains of numbness in her fingers and perioral area. Her serum calcium level is 6 mg/dl. Which of the following vessels would have been injured during the surgery, resulting in this clinical scenario?

options.label: A
options.text: Anterior branch of superior thyroid artery

options.label: B
options.text: Posterior branch of superior thyroid artery

options.label: C
options.text: Superior branch of inferior thyroid artery

options.label: D
options.text: Inferior branch of inferior thyroid artery
